fixed.explanation: BaseGrouper.indices passes per-grouping codes, which are in first-appearance order when sort=False, together with self.levels. With observed=False the levels are in category order, so labels and rows are mismatched. The fix recomputes the per-row codes from result_index and ids in this case, so they match result_index. I limited the new path to multi-key groupings with a categorical key, unsorted groups and dropna=True, to keep the NaN handling elsewhere unchanged.
